#+TITLE: Artifact-only source production demo

The actual source macro in artifact/demo/values.bl evaluates a computed value
through a private helper and generates answer. The consumer also carries a
runtime-computed value, captured closure and observable initializer.

The producer keeps an already loaded answer returning 7 while preparing and
emitting replacement artifacts. A fresh consumer has no fixture source paths:
it validates bytes, refuses a deliberate mutation before loading, activates
through existing publication/initialization guards and returns 42. The runtime
value is 3, the captured closure returns 42, and initialization occurs once.
The emitted answer descriptor is checked against its loaded body attributes.

Run from the checkout with Elixir/OTP on PATH, under a process-tree limit:
#+begin_src sh
scripts/bl-mem
systemd-run --user --collect --wait --pipe --working-directory="$PWD" \
  --property=MemoryMax=6G --property=MemorySwapMax=0 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=300 \
  env PATH="$PATH" scripts/demo-artifact-production --out .local/execution/my-demo
#+end_src
The output must be absent/empty. It retains manifests, artifacts, logs and a
scoped result.json. No installed floor is changed. Temporary source images and
their VMs are cleaned up; producer and consumer run serially.

Public Source preparation uses quoted namespace symbols:
#+begin_src clojure
(let [workspace (BeamLisp.AOT/open_workspace
                  {:version 1 :roots (list root)
                   :sources (list {:namespace 'artifact.demo.values :file values-file}
                                  {:namespace 'artifact.demo.consumer :file consumer-file})} {})]
 (try
  (let [unit (BeamLisp.AOT/prepare_unit workspace 'artifact.demo.consumer)]
   (BeamLisp.AOT/emit_unit unit output))
  (finally (BeamLisp.AOT/close_workspace! workspace))))
#+end_src
Workspace handles are process-local compiler data. Artifacts and verification
reports grant no SDK origin or native execution admission. Host preparation,
complete execution inventory and build/cache migration remain separate work.

--bootstrap-probe additionally attempts the real protected rt.bl as a third,
independent phase. It must preserve loaded runtime identities and generations.
This is a diagnostic gate, not full compiler self-reproduction. Its current
failure is retained separately from the successful Source producer/consumer demo.
